accepted.evidence: Turner 9348 expressly lists Pashai bai 'good' under bhagín, alongside Shumashti and Gawri bäi. Lehr's Darrai bai has the same form and sense.
Turner 1179 gives Pashai alenā/alinā 'blue, green' under ānīla. Lehr's Darrai alina 'green' is the same adjective; its unmarked final vowel length is preserved.
Turner 1179 gives Pashai alinā 'blue, green' exactly; Lehr's Darrai alinā 'green' matches form and sense.

Turner 4407 §2 expressly lists Pashai gaṛ- 'to send' under ghaṭayati. Lehr's Darrai gaṛ- 'send, mail' is the exact stem, and the source's extension to mail is retained. The graph has one unsplit 4407 parent node; §2 is documented here.
Turner 8140 gives Pashai paṣī́ 'wall' from pāṣī́ 'stone, rock'. Lehr's Darrai paśi 'wall' has a closely matching palatal sibilant and the exact local sense; the source transcription is preserved.
